description.value:
This braided sea kelp rope writhes slowly when submerged in water.

Activate 1 (manipulate)

Requirements The target is in water

Effect The sea retrieval line uncoils and stretches through the water toward a target of your choice—an unattended, stationary object or willing creature of 10 Bulk or less. The end of the rope moves 20 feet when you Activate it and at the start of each of your turns, to a maximum length of 120 feet, until it reaches the target or runs out of length. Once it reaches the target, the vine pulls the unattended object or willing creature toward you, or pulls you toward the stationary object, at the same rate.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
